title: Hippos make their own SUNSCREEN?! 🦛 #shorts
description:
Gizmo Jr. says nature can't surprise him… wrong again. 🤖
Fizzo brought three animal facts that sound fake but are 100% true. ⚡

Which one got you? Comment below! 👇
Follow for a new mind-blowing fact every day!

#facts #funfacts #didyouknow #animals #shorts
facts_checked: Hippos make their own sunscreen: their skin oozes a red-orange 'sweat' (hipposudoric acid pigments) that blocks sunlight and fights germs (Nature, 2004).
Sharks are older than trees: sharks appeared about 450 million years ago, the first trees about 385-390 million years ago.
A shrimp's heart is in its head (the cephalothorax, the head-and-chest section).
